'''Pepise Slamen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] as part of the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], and was stationed at the Ion Capacitor room of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. He was confronted and killed by rebel forces.
